NCT03460704.eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Age 40 to 80 years
* Physician-diagnosed COPD, post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC < 0.70
* Post-bronchodilator FEV1 between 30% and 60% of predicted
* At least 2 moderate or severe COPD exacerbations in the previous 12 months
* Current or former smoker with at least 10 pack-years

Exclusion Criteria:
* Current diagnosis of asthma
* COPD exacerbation within 4 weeks before screening
* Lung volume reduction surgery within the previous 12 months
NCT03460704.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in trough FEV1 at Week 12

NCT05000001.eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Age 18 to 75 years
* HbA1c between 7.0% and 10.5%
* BMI 25 to 40 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:
* Type 1 diabetes
* eGFR below 45 mL/min/1.73 m2
NCT05000001.primary_endpoint: Change in HbA1c from baseline at Week 26

NCT05000002.eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Age 18 to 65 years
* Serum AAT below 11 uM
* FEV1 between 35% and 70% of predicted

Exclusion Criteria:
* IgA deficiency
NCT05000002.primary_endpoint: Change in CT lung density at Week 52
